description: A contemporary retelling where greed and social status play out through astrologers with tablets, cash payouts, security-gated estates, and a fortress-like “dragon” compound—keeping the folktale’s bargains, swapped letter, and poetic justice while grounding it in today’s money, mobility, and institutions.
summary: A ruthless modern trader tries to outrun a prophecy, only to be trapped by it and punished by his own greed.
